Solid solution strengthening of Si on Nb is considered to be the main reason due to the obvious difference of the atom radius between Nb and Si.

Another possible reason for improving micro-hardness is precipitation hardening. Hard and brittle Nb3Si precipitates disperse in Nb matrix, which would contribute to enhance the micro-hardness of NbSS.
Fracture toughness is reduced gradually with the Si addition from 1 at.% to 3.5 at.%. This may be due to the grain boundary embrittlement.
